svg.text: Garage Door (ESP32 + HC-05). Bright = do it now, faded = already done.
Every GND -> BLUE (-) rail, every VCC -> RED (+) rail (5V pin of the ESP32). No resistors needed.
Phone: pair HC-05 (PIN 1234), open the GarageDoor app, SCAN BLUETOOTH -> HC-05.
OPEN DOOR / CLOSE DOOR. CLOSE is refused while a vehicle is in front of the sensor.
